items.question: What distinct ritual effects arise from using china-rose flowers and arrow flowers?
premises: China-rose flowers are specified as the ritual means.
World-subjugation is named as the effect associated with china-rose flowers.
Arrow flowers are specified as another ritual means.
Enchantment is named as the effect associated with arrow flowers.
items.inference: Different ritual flowers produce different specific effects: china-rose flowers bring world-subjugation, while arrow flowers bring enchantment.
uncertainties: The governing verb is implied from the preceding context rather than stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: With china-rose flowers one achieves subjugation of the world, and with arrow flowers one achieves enchantment.
